meta.name: ecommerce-full-pipeline
meta.description: 电商运营在开展跨境电商或闲鱼捡漏业务时，若需解决选品难、上架繁琐等痛点，必用此技能！一键打通“爆品挖掘→1688采集→多平台上架→推广文案→短视频生成”全自动流水线，轻松实现端到端自动化，让开店运营效率翻倍。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成从爆品挖掘到上架推广的电商全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做跨境电商或闲鱼捡漏，想省掉选品上架的繁琐
copy.tagline_en: Automate the full ecommerce flow from product discovery to listing and promotion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do cross-border or Xianyu sales and want to skip manual listing.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能按命令跑电商流程:从 1688 采集商品、清洗数据,生成微信小店/Shopify/TikTok 上架模板与推广文案,还给闲鱼二手商品打分、做竖屏短视频、代发下单。
howto.when: 当你提到选品、上架、捡漏等需求,或要做跨境电商、闲鱼选品买卖时触发。

say.text: 用 1688 采集蓝牙耳机,抓 2 页详情并下载图片
say.note: 执行 scrape 命令,输出原始商品数据

say.text: 帮我在闲鱼找投影仪,预算 999,要 4K 和云台
say.note: 执行 hunt,按参数匹配给出评分结果

say.text: 跑全自动流水线,种子词用收纳盒和蓝牙耳机
say.note: 依次挖掘、采集、上架、推广、生成视频

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can run e-commerce pipelines: scrape 1688 products, clean data, build listing templates for WeChat Shop/Shopify/TikTok plus ad copy, score Xianyu bargains, make vertical videos, and place dropship orders.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need cross-border e-commerce or Xianyu sourcing help, e.g. product picking, listings, or promo videos.

say_en.text: Scrape Bluetooth earphones from 1688, 2 pages with details and images
say_en.note: Runs the scrape command and saves product data

say_en.text: Hunt Xianyu for a projector under 999 with 4K and gimbal
say_en.note: Runs hunt and prints scored results

say_en.text: Run the auto pipeline with seed keywords storage box and earphones
say_en.note: Runs trend, scrape, publish, promote, video in order
